title: Ceph客户端吞吐低但OSD设备利用率不高时应检查什么？
answer: 按同一字节流、固定PG8镜像与映射逐项比较客户端数、QD、块大小和flush策略；F单列真实PG1对照。实际librbd调用、独立全读SHA与原生CPU/perf/socket及PG映射共同审查，设备未满不能排除客户端/网络/热点瓶颈；不预设QD一定改善或短样本生产SLO。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: Static formal practice draft only. v2 native capability is context, not this source acceptance. Matched fixed PG8image/reset, separate completion/finalflush, captured C/nativePopen and late taskimport, current-callfullread and repeat-request guard; author/nativewrongmatrix/nonauthor/App pending.
body:
## 操作任务
Ceph客户端吞吐低而设备利用率不高，仍应逐项检查客户端并发、块大小、同步写、队列深度、网络及单PG热点。实现task.py唯一入口measure(images,case)，用标准librbd方法形状的薄转发执行真实IO、完整读取和flush，返回完整字节流SHA。不能用计划JSON、预期哈希、假工厂/进程输出或进度文字代替实际操作。
教师建立自有MON/core MGR及3个512MiB普通文件BlueStore OSD、size2/min1的PG8与PG1池、两个layering-only镜像（4MiB，object_order19，8个实际data对象）。四个独立Rados会话及未借出的teacher会话各用独立admin_socket/cachefalse，原helper配置和默认身份保留，实际features无exclusive-lock。真实SDK工厂、C方法、native Popen在task导入前捕获；原生镜像、初始字节与SDK closures建立后才导入task。
A/B/C/D/E/A2共用同一个PG8镜像及其实际object→PG→acting映射，每阶段由teacher恢复相同初始字节并独立全读确认；F单列真实PG1镜像。全部阶段写同一4MiB最终流并独立全读SHA：A=1client/QD1/64KiB/末端flush；B=1client/QD4/64KiB；C=4client各QD1（聚合QD4，与B保持聚合上限）；D=1client/QD1/64KiB每写flush；E=1client/QD1/4KiB（总字节固定，不比较相同操作数）；F=PG1、其他同A；A2为括号基线。没有规定哪项必须更快。
## 公开接口与完整返回结构
measure(images,case) -> {"bytes":int,"sha256":str,"skipped":bool}，必须恰好这三个字段。bytes是严格整数4194304，sha256必须来自本次实际最终流读取，skipped为严格bool。首轮每个阶段已恢复初始流，必须执行全部操作并返回skipped=False；同阶段紧接重复调用时原生内容已完整，应通过本次真实全读确认并返回skipped=True，零write/flush请求（即使请求将成为no-op或失败也先记录并拒绝），不能依赖本地标记、已存manifest或跨调用缓存。每次的最终全读取须在全部写完成/flush后覆盖offset0到length；允许分段读取。
images为1个或4个已打开实际Image上下文的只读包装列表，不要关闭/替换它们。方法保持librbd参数顺序：read(offset,length,fadvise_flags=0)->bytes；aio_write(data:bytes,offset:int,oncomplete,fadvise_flags=0)->Completion；flush()->None或原生异常。只允许fadvise_flags=0及本题长度范围。Completion支持is_complete()、get_return_value()、wait_for_complete_and_cb()；is_complete不表示callback已结束，应reap每个Completion并检查真实return_value=0，回调不要阻塞等待自身。只有列出的标准方法被借出，无新业务API或数据库。
case结构：label为A/B/C/D/E/F/A2；length=4194304；sha256为最终流参考SHA；block_bytes为65536或4096；queue_depth为1或4（每client上限）；flush_each为bool；client_session_ids为当前images对应的真实Rados全局ID列表；operations=[{"offset":int,"data":bytes},...]，按offset升序完整覆盖最终流。必须按operations顺序提交，编号i分配images[i%len(images)]，精确匹配data/offset/块大小，不能遗漏、重复或改总字节。先填充允许的初始聚合窗口，再等待完成；后续仍有该client待提交操作时，先补满该client窗口再阻塞等待，防止把串行执行当QD4。回收完所有Completion后，每个参与Image必须一次末端flush；D还要求每个write完成后、下一个submit前实际flush。C末端有4次flush，B有1次，teacher将数据completion窗口与末端flush开销分开保存，不能混为纯客户端并发增益。
首轮可先真实读取当前内容判断是否已完成，然后执行提交/回收/flush/最终全读；重复轮必须只通过当前读取判断。teacher有独立的dispatch前请求、真实C completion、flush和当前调用完整读区间回执，不信返回的计划或自报指标。无关外部命令、私有teacher反射/修改证据或额外线程进程不在此有限接口范围；本题不是任意恶意代码沙箱。
## 原生调查与风险边界
teacher保留每操作真实时间/错误/字节、配置、固定映射、实际QD重叠、CPU jiffies、OSD/client native perf及真实socket证据。CPU为本进程总计，含所有Rados原生线程及记录开销；/proc/net是网络namespace范围，只有fd inode过滤的连接可归到自有PID，lo计数也含并行负载。AsyncMessenger聚合可能混合client/复制/heartbeat/admin，MON使用v1或配置/地址广播不能证明全部数据流协议。结合这些原始证据检查网络与PG热点，不额外要求tc/物理网络故障。
这是同宿主文件OSD/loopback功能调查，不认证物理SSD/NIC利用率、生产p99/SLO；callback含调度/GIL/记录开销，实际client outstanding不等于设备硬件队列。块大小改变也改变调用/记录次数，原始耗时不独立证明生产因果；不能由loopback低利用率判断物理盘空闲。SDK/JSON/timeout/后端未就绪保留原生或RuntimeError，不当作错误答案被有效拒绝。
## 产物
task.py，包含measure(images,case)及必要的普通辅助函数。
## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py
公开run和验收命令一致；stock120秒、内部115秒且自有资源清理无条件计入。reference/未完成/错误/投机/合法替代及实际导入等需绑定该源独立验证；本稿pending，不复用capability作为正式源通过。
hints: RBD.read参数是offset,length；与RADOS对象read接口不同。先真实读当前完整流判断重复，再按窗口pipeline提交/回收。
不要仅看is_complete；wait_for_complete_and_cb会保留callback错误，逐Completion检查原生return_value。
rubric: 按相同4MiB协议逐项检查客户端数/QD/块大小/同步flush，并保持PG8同镜像同映射及相同恢复流
真实SDK提交、C completion与flush；完整当前调用实际读与独立teacher全SHA，不能只返计划JSON
四个不同Rados会话和真实重叠、PG1实际热点对照、CPU/perf/network/mixedmessenger原始证据范围准确
重复当前内容验证且dispatch前零mutation请求，setup/runtime失败不冒semantic拒绝
区分数据completion与末端flush/观测开销，不预设吞吐排名或宣称物理利用率与短样本SLO

exercise.environment: Ceph19.2.3 own real3x512MiB fileBlueStore/MON/core MGR, four distinctRados sessions, nativeImage/C methods/childPopen captured, fixedmatchedRBDdata mapping, student1000 andfrozen tools

"""Experimental nonroot, private MON/bluestore OSD; no question or incident credit."""
import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados

def record_native(row):
 with (pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/native-commands.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf8')as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
if os.geteuid()!=1000:raise RuntimeError('nativeUID mismatch: '+str(os.geteuid()))
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/tmp/opsforge-session07-20261029/native')
ENV={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20,_spawn=subprocess.Popen,_TimeoutExpired=subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
 argv=[str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)]
 process=_spawn(argv,env=ENV,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 try:out,err=process.communicate(timeout=timeout)
 except _TimeoutExpired:
  process.kill();out,err=process.communicate();record_native(dict(event='native_cli_timeout',pid=process.pid,argv=argv,stdout=out,stderr=err,returncode=process.returncode));raise
 record_native(dict(event='native_cli_completed',pid=process.pid,argv=argv,returncode=process.returncode,stdout=out,stderr=err))
 if process.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' privatecommand failed: '+out[-1000:]+err[-3000:])
 return out

def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-session07-disk062-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
plugin dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph
mon cluster log file = {root}/cluster.log
mon cluster log to file = false
fsid = {fsid}
mon initial members = a
mon host = 127.0.0.1:{port}
auth cluster required = none
auth service required = none
auth client required = none
public addr = 127.0.0.1
cluster addr = 127.0.0.1
ms bind ipv4 = true
ms bind ipv6 = false
ms async op threads = 1
log to stderr = true
log to file = false
run dir = {root}/run
crash dir = {root}/crash
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
admin socket = {root}/$name.asok
pid file = {root}/$name.pid
keyring = {root}/$name.keyring
mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true
osd pool default size = 1
osd pool default min size = 1
osd pool default pg num = 1
osd pool default pgp num = 1
osd pool default pg autoscale mode = off
osd crush chooseleaf type = 0
rados mon op timeout = 10
rados osd op timeout = 10
[mon.a]
mon data = {root}/mon.a
mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}
[osd]
osd objectstore = bluestore
bluestore block size = 536870912
bluestore block create = true
osd mclock skip benchmark = true
osd op queue = wpq
osd data = {root}/osd.$id
keyring = {root}/osd.$id/keyring
osd memory target = 134217728
bluestore device bytes = 134217728
osd op num shards = 1
osd op num threads per shard = 1
osd op num shards hdd = 1
osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1
osd op num shards ssd = 1
osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     if status['monmap']['fsid']!=self.fsid:raise RuntimeError('nativeFSID mismatch: '+json.dumps(status))
     break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args,_spawn=subprocess.Popen):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=_spawn([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  record_native({'event':'process_start','pid':process.pid,'argv':process.args,'owned_root':str(self.root),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':ENV.get('PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')})
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  record_native({'mon_command':{'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs},'rc':rc,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':err})
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','bluestore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','bluestore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_FILE_BLUESTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()
  record_native({'event':'cleanup','owned_root':str(self.root),'root_exists':self.root.exists(),'processes':[{'pid':p.pid,'returncode':p.poll()}for p in self.processes]})
